summary: This directory serves as the dedicated test suite for the documentation and schema guiding module, focusing on validating the transformation of schema data, the integrity of annotation checks, and the final rendering of guidance content.
responsibilities: Verify the accuracy of schema normalization logic
Validate the correctness of annotation check analysis
Test the output generation of schema documentation guides
relationships: The test suite validates the normalization of schema structures before they are processed by the annotation analysis logic.
The rendering tests ensure that the final schema guides accurately represent the results of schema normalization and annotation analysis.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files within the module directory to maintain proximity to the source code
Functional testing approach to verify component outputs based on provided schema inputs
